description: Trigger an Argo Workflow run via the Argo Server REST API. Supports partitions_def (daily/weekly/monthly/hourly/cron/static/dynamic/multi-axis) with {partition_key}/{date}/{partition.<dim>} substitution in parameters values. wait_for_completion polls GET /api/v1/workflows/{namespace}/{name} to a terminal phase, fails on Failed/Error/Omitted, and surfaces status.outputs.parameters as materialization metadata. demo_mode=true (default) simulates the whole submit/poll lifecycle on stdout with zero external dependencies.

asset_key.label: Asset Key
asset_key.description: Dagster asset key for the workflow (e.g. 'argo/etl/nightly_aggregation'). Use '/' separators.

workflow_template.label: Workflow Template
workflow_template.description: Argo WorkflowTemplate name to instantiate. Set this OR workflow_manifest, not both.

workflow_manifest.label: Workflow Manifest
workflow_manifest.description: Full Argo Workflow manifest as a dict (apiVersion / kind / metadata / spec). Use this for one-off workflows that aren't pre-registered as templates. Set this OR workflow_template, not both.

parameters.label: Parameters
parameters.description: Workflow parameters (key=value). Passed via submitOptions.parameters as `name=value` strings.

host_env_var.label: Host Env Var
host_env_var.description: Env var with the Argo Server URL.

token_env_var.label: Token Env Var
token_env_var.description: Env var with the bearer token. Leave empty for anonymous-read clusters.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Simulate the Argo Server submit/poll lifecycle on stdout -- no cluster, no `requests` call, no env vars required. Flip to False and set host_env_var / token_env_var to hit a real Argo Server.

wait_for_completion.label: Wait For Completion
wait_for_completion.description: Poll GET /api/v1/workflows/{namespace}/{name} until the workflow reaches a terminal phase. Fails the asset on Failed/Error/Omitted; surfaces status.outputs.parameters as materialization metadata on success. When False (default) the asset returns as soon as Argo accepts the submission -- pair with argo_workflow_sensor (asset_event_type=observation) to record terminal status.

poll_timeout_seconds.label: Poll Timeout Seconds
poll_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for a terminal phase before failing (wait_for_completion only).

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying time-window partitions definition.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the partitions definition (defaults to UTC).

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
